author: Eulerlalala
quote: A game ruined by a repulsive narrative. Lucia and Jason have zero real chemistry, and their sudden shifts from petty criminals to chaotic anti-heroes make no sense. Worse, the pacing is a total mess—it drags endlessly through filler errands in the first half, only to rush the climax with a series of predictable, unearned betrayals. By the time the credits rolled, I didn't care about a single character's fate. Amazing open world, completely hollow narrative.
